contract.definition: item: Item = Item.allInstances()->any(i: Item | i.Barcode = barcode)
contract.precondition: self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and quantity > 0 and item.oclIsUndefined() = false and item.StockNumber > 0 and quantity <= item.StockNumber
contract.postcondition: result = true and item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber@pre - quantity and (let sl: SalesLineItem in sl.oclIsNew() and SalesLineItem.allInstances()->includes(sl) and sl.Quantity = quantity and sl.Subamount = item.Price * quantity and sl.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and sl.BelongedItem = item and self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(sl) and self.CurrentSaleLine = sl)
